/fuar-standi/.title: Fuar standınız, markanızın en güçlü sahnesi.
/fuar-standi/.lead: Yurt içi ve yurt dışı fuarlarda standınızı tasarlıyor, kendi atölyemizde üretiyor, nakliye ve kurulumuyla anahtar teslim yönetiyoruz.

highlights.title: Özgün tasarım
highlights.text: Kurumsal kimliğinize ve hedef kitlenize göre size özel stand konsepti.

highlights.title: Kendi üretimimiz
highlights.text: Ahşap ve modüler stand elemanları kendi atölyemizde üretilir.

highlights.title: Yurt içi ve yurt dışı
highlights.text: İstanbul'dan Avrupa, Amerika ve Ortadoğu'daki fuarlara kurulum.

highlights.title: Zamanında teslim
highlights.text: Lojistik, kurulum ve söküm tek elden, fuar takvimine göre planlanır.

intro.title: Bir organizasyon değil, uzun soluklu bir marka dostluğu.
intro.text: Fuar standınızın kalitesi ve prestiji bizi de temsil eder. Kurumsal renklerinizi, markanızı ve hedef kitlenizi analiz ederek size özel kreatif bir stand tasarlıyor; tasarımdan üretime, lojistikten kuruluma kadar her ölçekte projeyi anahtar teslim yönetiyoruz.

offerings.title: Özel tasarım ahşap stand
offerings.text: Tamamen kişiselleştirilmiş, detayların ön planda olduğu standlar. Markanızı en iyi şekilde yansıtmak ve benzersiz bir görsel etki yaratmak istediğiniz fuarlar için.

offerings.title: Modüler (Maxima) stand
offerings.text: Hızlı kurulup sökülebilen, tekrar kullanılabilen modüler sistem. Sık fuara katılan ve maliyeti kontrol etmek isteyen markalar için.

offerings.title: Kongre standı
offerings.text: Tıp, ilaç, finans ve teknoloji gibi bilgi yoğun sektörlerde, kompakt alanda prestijli ve profesyonel bir izlenim için.

offerings.title: AVM ve pop-up stand
offerings.text: Yüksek yaya trafiğinde dikkat çeken, taşınabilir ve tekrar kurulabilen satış ve deneyim alanları.

process.title: Brief ve fuar bilgisi
process.text: Fuar, salon, stand numarası, metrekare ve açık cephe sayısı; markanızın hedefi ve teşhir edilecek ürünler netleşir.

process.title: Konsept ve 3D tasarım
process.text: Kurumsal renkleriniz ve hedef kitleniz analiz edilerek size özel stand konsepti ve 3D görseller hazırlanır.

process.title: Teknik proje ve onay
process.text: Fuar kurallarına uygun teknik çizimler, elektrik ve aydınlatma planı hazırlanır; organizatör onayı alınır.

process.title: Atölyede üretim
process.text: Stand elemanları ve teşhir üniteleri kendi atölyemizde üretilir, montaj öncesi kontrol edilir.

process.title: Lojistik ve kurulum
process.text: Yurt içi ve yurt dışı nakliye, kurulum ve fuar boyunca teknik destek tek elden yönetilir.

process.title: Söküm ve depolama
process.text: Fuar sonunda stand sökülür; tekrar kullanılabilir elemanlar sonraki katılımlar için değerlendirilir.

blocks.title: Sektörünüze göre stand
blocks.lead: Her sektörün ziyaretçi beklentisi ve teşhir ihtiyacı farklıdır. Standın kurgusunu sektörünüze göre uyarlıyoruz.

items.title: Enerji ve yenilenebilir enerji
items.text: Büyük ekipman teşhirine uygun açık planlar, sürdürülebilir malzemeler ve teknolojik vurgular.

items.title: Gıda ve içecek
items.text: Hijyenik teşhir üniteleri, tadım ve ikram alanları, sıcak ve davetkâr bir atmosfer.

items.title: Tekstil ve hazır giyim
items.text: Koleksiyon sunumuna uygun askı ve vitrin sistemleri, güçlü aydınlatma.

items.title: Otomotiv ve makine
items.text: Ağır ürünleri taşıyabilen zemin çözümleri ve ürün odaklı, dramatik aydınlatma.

blocks.title: Stand bütçesini ne belirler?
blocks.lead: Fuar standı fiyatı tek bir kalemle açıklanamaz; toplam maliyet birkaç değişkenin bileşimidir.

items.title: Metrekare ve stand tipi
items.text: Ada, yarımada, köşe veya sıra stand; açık cephe sayısı maliyeti belirler.

items.title: Malzeme ve işçilik
items.text: Tamamen özel ahşap üretim ile modüler sistem arasında ciddi fark vardır.

items.title: Teknoloji ve aydınlatma
items.text: LED, ekran ve interaktif üniteler bütçeyi artırır ama etkiyi yükseltir.

items.title: Lojistik ve kurulum
items.text: Özellikle yurt dışı katılımlarda nakliye ve montaj önemli bir kalemdir.

process.title: Konsept ve tasarım

process.title: Teknik proje

process.title: Üretim ve uygulama

process.title: Kontrol ve teslim
process.text: Detaylar yerinde kontrol edilir, mekân kullanıma hazır teslim edilir. Ruhsat hariç tüm süreçler bizdedir.

scope.title: Konsept tasarım

scope.title: Teknik proje

scope.title: Anahtar teslim uygulama

/en/service/expo-design/.title: Your exhibition stand: your brand's strongest stage.
/en/service/expo-design/.lead: We design your stand for fairs in Türkiye and abroad, build it in our own workshop and deliver it turnkey, including transport and installation.

highlights.title: Original design
highlights.text: A stand concept made for you, based on your corporate identity and target audience.

highlights.title: In-house production
highlights.text: Timber and modular stand elements are built in our own workshop.

highlights.title: At home and abroad
highlights.text: Installation from Istanbul to fairs across Europe, America and the Middle East.

highlights.title: On-time delivery
highlights.text: Logistics, installation and dismantling from a single source, planned around the fair calendar.

intro.title: Not just an event, but a long-term partnership with your brand.
intro.text: The quality and prestige of your stand represent us too. We analyse your corporate colours, brand and target audience to design a creative stand made for you, and we manage projects of every size turnkey, from design and production to logistics and installation.

offerings.title: Custom timber stand
offerings.text: Fully personalised stands where the details take centre stage. For fairs where you want to present your brand at its best and make a unique visual impact.

offerings.title: Modular (Maxima) stand
offerings.text: A reusable modular system that is quick to set up and dismantle. For brands that exhibit often and want to keep costs under control.

offerings.title: Congress stand
offerings.text: For a prestigious, professional impression in a compact space, in knowledge-intensive sectors such as medicine, pharmaceuticals, finance and technology.

offerings.title: Mall and pop-up stand
offerings.text: Portable, re-installable sales and experience spaces that stand out in high foot traffic.

/en/service/expo-design/.processTitle: How is an exhibition stand prepared?

process.title: Brief and fair details
process.text: The fair, hall, stand number, floor area and number of open sides are defined, along with your brand's goals and the products to be displayed.

process.title: Concept and 3D design
process.text: We analyse your corporate colours and target audience to create a bespoke stand concept and 3D visuals.

process.title: Technical drawings and approval
process.text: Technical drawings and electrical and lighting plans are prepared in line with the fair's regulations, and the organiser's approval is obtained.

process.title: Workshop production
process.text: Stand elements and display units are built in our own workshop and checked before installation.

process.title: Logistics and installation
process.text: Domestic and international transport, installation and technical support throughout the fair are managed by a single team.

process.title: Dismantling and storage
process.text: After the fair the stand is dismantled; reusable elements are kept for your next participations.

blocks.title: Stands for your sector
blocks.lead: Every sector has different visitor expectations and display needs. We adapt the stand's layout to your sector.

items.title: Energy and renewables
items.text: Open layouts suited to large equipment displays, sustainable materials and a focus on technology.

items.title: Food and beverage
items.text: Hygienic display units, tasting and hospitality areas, and a warm, inviting atmosphere.

items.title: Textiles and apparel
items.text: Hanging and showcase systems suited to presenting collections, with strong lighting.

items.title: Automotive and machinery
items.text: Flooring that can carry heavy products and dramatic, product-focused lighting.

blocks.title: What determines a stand budget?
blocks.lead: The price of an exhibition stand can't be explained by a single item; the total cost is a combination of several variables.

items.title: Floor area and stand type
items.text: Island, peninsula, corner or row stand: the number of open sides determines the cost.

items.title: Materials and workmanship
items.text: There is a significant difference between a fully custom timber build and a modular system.

items.title: Technology and lighting
items.text: LEDs, screens and interactive units increase the budget but also the impact.

items.title: Logistics and installation
items.text: Transport and assembly are a major item, especially for fairs abroad.

/de/service/messe-stand/.title: Ihr Messestand – die stärkste Bühne Ihrer Marke.
/de/service/messe-stand/.lead: Wir entwerfen Ihren Stand für Messen im In- und Ausland, fertigen ihn in unserer eigenen Werkstatt und liefern ihn schlüsselfertig – inklusive Transport und Aufbau.

highlights.title: Individuelles Design
highlights.text: Ein Standkonzept speziell für Sie, abgestimmt auf Ihre Corporate Identity und Zielgruppe.

highlights.title: Eigene Fertigung
highlights.text: Holz- und Systemstandelemente entstehen in unserer eigenen Werkstatt.

highlights.title: Im In- und Ausland
highlights.text: Aufbau von Istanbul aus für Messen in Europa, Amerika und im Nahen Osten.

highlights.title: Pünktliche Übergabe
highlights.text: Logistik, Aufbau und Abbau aus einer Hand, geplant nach dem Messekalender.

intro.title: Kein einmaliger Auftrag, sondern eine langfristige Markenpartnerschaft.
intro.text: Qualität und Ansehen Ihres Messestands stehen auch für uns. Wir analysieren Ihre Unternehmensfarben, Ihre Marke und Ihre Zielgruppe, entwerfen einen kreativen Stand speziell für Sie und realisieren Projekte jeder Größe schlüsselfertig – vom Design über die Fertigung und Logistik bis zum Aufbau.

offerings.title: Individueller Holzstand
offerings.text: Vollständig individualisierte Stände, bei denen die Details im Vordergrund stehen. Für Messen, auf denen Sie Ihre Marke optimal präsentieren und eine unverwechselbare visuelle Wirkung erzielen möchten.

offerings.title: Systemstand (Maxima)
offerings.text: Ein wiederverwendbares Modulsystem, das sich schnell auf- und abbauen lässt. Für Marken, die häufig ausstellen und ihre Kosten im Griff behalten möchten.

offerings.title: Kongressstand
offerings.text: Für einen hochwertigen, professionellen Auftritt auf kompakter Fläche in wissensintensiven Branchen wie Medizin, Pharma, Finanzen und Technologie.

offerings.title: Einkaufszentrum- und Pop-up-Stand
offerings.text: Mobile, wieder aufbaubare Verkaufs- und Erlebnisflächen, die bei hoher Besucherfrequenz auffallen.

process.title: Briefing und Messedaten
process.text: Messe, Halle, Standnummer, Fläche und Anzahl der offenen Seiten werden geklärt, ebenso die Ziele Ihrer Marke und die auszustellenden Produkte.

process.title: Konzept und 3D-Design
process.text: Wir analysieren Ihre Unternehmensfarben und Zielgruppe und entwickeln ein individuelles Standkonzept mit 3D-Visualisierungen.

process.title: Technische Planung und Freigabe
process.text: Technische Zeichnungen sowie Elektro- und Beleuchtungspläne werden nach den Messerichtlinien erstellt und vom Veranstalter freigegeben.

process.title: Fertigung in der Werkstatt
process.text: Standelemente und Präsentationsmodule werden in unserer eigenen Werkstatt gefertigt und vor der Montage geprüft.

process.title: Logistik und Aufbau
process.text: Transport im In- und Ausland, Aufbau und technischer Support während der Messe kommen aus einer Hand.

process.title: Abbau und Lagerung
process.text: Nach der Messe wird der Stand abgebaut; wiederverwendbare Elemente werden für Ihre nächsten Messeauftritte genutzt.

blocks.title: Ein Stand für Ihre Branche
blocks.lead: Jede Branche hat andere Besuchererwartungen und Präsentationsanforderungen. Wir passen das Standkonzept an Ihre Branche an.

items.title: Energie und erneuerbare Energien
items.text: Offene Grundrisse für die Präsentation großer Anlagen, nachhaltige Materialien und technologische Akzente.

items.title: Lebensmittel und Getränke
items.text: Hygienische Präsentationsmodule, Verkostungs- und Bewirtungsbereiche, eine warme und einladende Atmosphäre.

items.title: Textil und Bekleidung
items.text: Hänge- und Vitrinensysteme für die Präsentation von Kollektionen, mit kraftvoller Beleuchtung.

items.title: Automobil und Maschinenbau
items.text: Bodenlösungen für schwere Exponate und eine produktorientierte, dramatische Beleuchtung.

blocks.title: Was bestimmt das Standbudget?
blocks.lead: Der Preis eines Messestands lässt sich nicht mit einer einzelnen Position erklären; die Gesamtkosten ergeben sich aus mehreren Faktoren.

items.title: Fläche und Standtyp
items.text: Insel-, Kopf-, Eck- oder Reihenstand: Die Anzahl der offenen Seiten bestimmt die Kosten.

items.title: Material und Verarbeitung
items.text: Zwischen einer komplett individuellen Holzfertigung und einem Systemstand besteht ein erheblicher Unterschied.

items.title: Technik und Beleuchtung
items.text: LEDs, Bildschirme und interaktive Elemente erhöhen das Budget, steigern aber auch die Wirkung.

items.title: Logistik und Aufbau
items.text: Vor allem bei Messen im Ausland sind Transport und Montage ein wichtiger Kostenfaktor.

process.title: Site survey and needs analysis
process.text: We inspect the space on site and take measurements; together we define how it will be used, the brief and the schedule.

process.title: Concept and design
process.text: Space planning, materials and lighting come together in a concept; decisions are made with 3D visuals.

process.title: Technical project
process.text: Construction drawings, detail drawings, room schedules and the work programme are prepared.

process.title: Production and implementation
process.text: Furniture and fixed joinery are made in our own workshop; construction and installation are carried out on site by one team.

process.title: Inspection and handover
process.text: Details are checked on site and the space is handed over ready to use. We handle every step except permits.
